Welcome, Our Dearest Guests

A note before the details — please read this first.

Welcome to our garden wedding — and thank you for travelling to Kent to share it. We met in a bookshop, fell in love in gardens, and we are getting married in the prettiest one we could find.

Everything you need is on this page: times, addresses, where to stay, what to wear, and the RSVP at the bottom. If anything is unclear, message us. We would rather answer twice than have you guess once.

— Sophia & James

❀ ❀ ❀

Our Story

How we met, and how we got here — in four moments.

2018 — A London Bookshop

We met between the shelves

Sophia was shelving poetry; James was looking for a gift and bought the wrong book on purpose, just to come back. He came back three times before he asked her name.

2019–2023 — The Garden Habit

Weekends in green places

Every free weekend became a garden — Kew, then Kent, then a small allotment of their own. James grows roses badly; Sophia grows everything else well. The habit never stopped.

October 2026 — In the Rose Garden

He asked among the roses

On a crisp autumn afternoon in this very garden, James asked properly, ring in a coat pocket, both families waiting at the tea room. Sophia said yes before he finished.

22 May 2027 — Today, With You

Now we want you in the room

Late spring, roses in bloom, and the people who made us who we are. That is the whole plan — and the only thing missing is you.

Venue, Travel & Stay

Flying in? Start here, then pick a hotel that fits your budget.

The Venue

Rosewood Manor Gardens, Kent — our recommended base if you want one place for the whole celebration.

Open in Google Maps →

Getting Here

London Gatwick Airport (LGW) is the nearest airport. Allow about 1 hour by car to the gardens in normal traffic — book your ride in advance for the main evening.

Parking & Shuttle

Parking is available at the venue where noted in the FAQ. There is no arranged shuttle between hotels, so please plan a ride for each evening and pre-book for late returns.

Where to Stay

Price bands are indicative for planning only — please confirm live rates when you book.

Budget — Kent guesthouses & innsIndicative band: lower nightly rates. Village inns near the gardens; allow a short drive to the venue.
Mid-range — Rosewood Village HotelIndicative band: mid nightly rates. A ten-minute drive from the gardens, with breakfast included.
Premium — Rosewood Manor Gardens (venue hotel)Indicative band: higher nightly rates. Stay where the wedding is — gardens at your door in the morning.

Travelling with children or elderly family? Tell us in the RSVP message and we will help you choose the most comfortable option.

A Note on Gifts

Your presence is the gift — truly. If you still wish to give, a contribution towards our honeymoon is welcome, and we will share details personally with anyone who asks. There is no online registry or payment link on this page, by design.

❀ ❀ ❀

Questions, Answered

Tap a question to open it.

Yes — children are welcome. Please include them in your guest count so we can seat and cater for them. The welcome evening on the lawn is the most child-friendly part.

Only if your invitation names a plus-one, or you have confirmed one with us directly. If unsure, write it in the RSVP message and we will confirm — seating is planned by name.

Parking is available at the manor car park, with overflow in the village hall field. Arrive by 2:30 PM for the easiest spot.

Garden formal, soft colours and florals welcome. Avoid plain white and stilettos on the lawn; wedges or flats are safest.

No gift is expected — your presence is the gift. If you wish to give, a honeymoon contribution is welcome; ask us personally for details.

May in Kent is usually mild, but the ceremony is partly outdoors — bring a light layer. The lawn is grass, so flat or wedge shoes are essential; the marquee is covered if it rains.
